scenes.title: Money home shouldn't cost a week
scenes.sub: Cross-border AUSD for families, on Monad
scenes.say: Millions of people in the UK send money home to Lagos, Accra and Nairobi every month. Today it costs a fee, a cut on the rate, and days of waiting. Vesta sends AUSD across borders in seconds, settled instantly through Agora.

scenes.title: Onboard with a passkey
scenes.sub: Mera passkey in, AUSD balance ready
scenes.say: Amina signs up with a Mera passkey. Just her face, no seed phrase. Her account opens with an AUSD balance on Monad, ready to send.

scenes.title: Send AUSD home
scenes.sub: Pick Mama, enter fifty dollars, confirm with Face ID
scenes.say: She picks Mama in Nigeria and enters fifty dollars. Vesta shows the live rate, a zero fee, and exactly what Mama gets. One confirmation with her passkey, and it's sent.

scenes.title: Settled instantly through Agora
scenes.sub: One transaction, from AUSD to payout
scenes.say: Here's that exact transaction on Monad testnet. The vault takes the AUSD, swaps it through Agora's Instant Settlement contract, and pays Mama out in the same transaction. No pending state, no second step.

scenes.title: Mama receives it
scenes.sub: A receipt she can open on any phone
scenes.say: On the other side, Mama gets a receipt she can open on any phone. Fifty dollars, the naira amount at the day's rate, settled by Agora, and a link to check it independently.

scenes.title: Built on Agora's contracts
scenes.sub: HouseVault.sendHome routes every send through the pair
scenes.say: Under the hood, every send home goes through Agora's pair inside HouseVault, with slippage protection. AUSD in, local currency out, settled in one block.

outro.title: Vesta
outro.sub: Money home in seconds. Settled by Agora.
